description: Check settings.json and create an evidence-grounded YouTube niche + top-tier upload timing research report and Digen-ready production prompts; never use paid generators or publish without explicit approval.
args: In the YouTube AI Factory workspace, FIRST read settings.json and run /research-router to honor research.provider, research.depth, target_countries, and fallback_to_gemini. Never use vidIQ tools in Gemini-only mode; in Auto mode check vidIQ MCP (https://mcp.vidiq.com/mcp) access and credits first, then fallback to Gemini only when authorized. Conduct dated, source-linked niche/topic research AND top-tier country (US/UK/CA/AU) upload best-time scheduling via `python3 factory.py upload-plan`. Create 3 original hooks per shortlisted concept plus 1 Digen-ready script/scene package (`factory.py new` / `pack`) for review. Do not call Digen MCP (https://api.digen.ai/v2/gateway/agent/openapi/mcp) to spend credits, make purchases, upload videos, or publish anything without explicit owner approval. Save output under research/ and episodes/ and report provider actually used.
